title: rpt plugin record
description: One plugin found by rpt plugins. Summary, usage and version come from the plugin's --describe answer and are absent when it gave none in time.

name.description: The verb: the file name without its rpt- prefix.

path.description: Absolute path of the program rpt <name> runs.

description.description: What a plugin prints for --describe: one JSON object on one line, then exit 0.

summary.description: One line: what the plugin does.

usage.description: One line, e.g. rpt parse-nuclei < results.jsonl.
